subject: Clarion Health — implementation ambassador handoff & kickoff request
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@clarionhealth.com>, Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@clarionhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: Clarion Health (CH-8472) — implementation ambassador & kickoff ask

Team — handing the Clarion Health deal over to CS for implementation. Quick context and what I need from you: 

Summary: Clarion signed a 12-month hosted contract for Redwood Dedicated (2x A100 equiv, streaming/chat + embeddings) — ARR $420k annualized. SOW signed but procurement needs the DocuSign countersign (link below). They have a hard go-live target tied to an internal conference: Dec 1.

What they care about: predictable sub-200ms token latency for chat, SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 13 months, data retention controls (ability to purge), and private networking to their VPC (we will use Dedicated with a peered VPC).

Technical/ops notes (see attachments):
- We validated model sizing in perf tests; expect 350 concurrent streams at peak.
- Clarion will provide an integration sandbox and a bot account for API keys.
- SAML metadata lives with their IdP (I attached the initial metadata sheet).

Recommended ownership (please confirm):
- Implementation lead (primary): Tessa Morgan — owns kickoff agenda, runbook, and sprint ownership.
- Customer Success (ongoing): Monica Patel — adoption and 90/180-day outcomes.
- Escalation / infra contact: Ben Carter — capacity planning and SLA ops.

Immediate asks:
1) Can CS commit to a kickoff week of Sept 20–24? We should aim for a 60–90m kickoff to align SAML, networking, and data flows.
2) Triage any blockers we should raise pre-kickoff (procurement, legal asks, technical approvals).
3) Please confirm owner assignments by EOD tomorrow so I can update the customer.

Attachments: CH-8472-SOW-v2.pdf, clarion-technical-iq.xlsx
DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/CLARION-CH8472-SOW
HubSpot: HS-43521

Thanks —
Priyom
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0118
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Clarion Health (CH-8472) — implementation ambassador & kickoff ask

Thanks Priyom — quick read and sounds good. Happy to own adoption and health after go-live. A couple of clarifying notes and requests: 

- I agree Tessa as implementation lead; Tessa, can you confirm you can run a technical preflight with their infra team the week prior to kickoff?
- We should confirm SAML attribute mappings early (email, groups, role). If Clarion's IdP team needs us to host metadata or provide SP-initiated flow, we'll need an engineer (Ben) for the initial exchange.
- Is there a staging dataset for quality monitoring (we want to set up evals + alerts before prod)? If not, ask them for a 2–3 hour representative export.

Notes for CS playbook (for handoff doc):
- Success metrics: weekly active agents, median response time <200ms, 30-day NPS target 8+.
- Adoption milestones: 30/60/90-day cadence with checkpoints tied to product adoption metrics.

I'm available for a short internal sync today 2–3pm PT or tomorrow morning.

Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Clarion Health (CH-8472) — implementation ambassador & kickoff ask

Copying Jorge on a couple of infra asks so we can unblock early: 

Pre-kick checklist items (I will own this doc and run it with Tessa):
- Confirm VPC peering network ranges and whether Clarion will provide a NAT gateway.
- Provide API service account credentials and initial rate limits for the staging environment.
- Confirm SAML metadata exchange and expected attribute names.
- Define token retention & KV cache purge windows; we need policy for 13-month retention + purge request process.
- Performance baseline: run a 30-min load test in staging to validate our autoscaler profile.

Attaching prekick-checklist.md (stub). Tessa — will you take point on scheduling the load test with Jorge? Suggest we set three 1-hour windows next week for testing.

Ben
Head of Reliability, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — happy to confirm owners. Tessa as implementation lead and Monica for adoption works for us. 

We can do kickoff on Tue, Sept 21 at 11:00am ET (that works for the infra and product teams here). I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm agenda items. Procurement is finalizing countersign on DocuSign; I shared the SOW with them and CC'd purchasing.

Pre-kick items from our side:
- We'll upload SAML metadata to the shared drive by Friday 9/17.
- Jorge will stand up a staging VPC and share network ranges by 9/17.
- Procurement will handle remaining items; point person is purchasing@clarionhealth.com.
